name: dsh-refcheck
description: DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: the refcheck_check model tool — verifies a paper's references against Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv (any input style: plain lines, APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, MLA, Vancouver, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX, .pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt files) and emits corrected citations in the detected style.
